name: Nothing Ear
author: frank
description: Nothing earbuds in the Omarchy bar: per-earbud and case battery, noise control, equalizer, bass enhance, low latency, find-my-earbuds, and the host audio codec.

barWidget.description: Battery, noise control, equalizer, low latency, find-my-earbuds and codec selection for Nothing earbuds, over their own Bluetooth control channel.

schema.label: Hide the icon while the earbuds are away
Show the battery percentage beside the icon
schema.description: Off leaves the artwork alone on the bar; the tooltip and panel still report the battery.

schema.label: Bluetooth address (optional)
schema.description: Leave empty to detect the pair automatically; the one carrying audio wins when several are connected.

schema.label: Path to nothing-earctl.py
schema.description: Leave empty to use the helper shipped with this plugin.

schema.label: Battery refresh interval (seconds)
schema.description: How often the bar icon re-reads the earbuds while they are connected (15-900).
